newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore government securities end narrowly mixed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore government securities end narrowly mixed.

text.p: Singapore government securities ended narrowly mixed in moderate trade on Wednesday on retail and interbank interest, dealers said.

"Government securities were narrowly mixed today amid uncertainty over market direction. Treasury bill yields were steady to easier but bond prices were steady to slightly higher. Volume was moderate," a local dealer said.
In treasury bills, three-months closed at a yield of 2.00/1.95 percent compared with Tuesday's yield of 2.03/1.98 percent but one-year was unchanged from Tuesday's yield of 1.57/1.52 percent.
Among bonds, July 1998 was unchanged from Tuesday's close of S$99.32/99.37.
September 2001 ended at S$99.36/99.41 against Tuesday's close of S$99.35/99.40 and June 2003 at S$98.93/98.98 versus S$98.90/98.95.
The overnight interbank offered rate was unchanged from Tuesday's 3-1/4 3-1/8 percent.
